rationale: The system failed to retrieve any of the 6 expected alternate names for CAPEC-512 (Man-in-the-Middle / MITM, Monkey-in-the-Middle, Monster-in-the-Middle, On-path Attacker, Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM, and Side-Channel Attack) due to a technical failure in the CAPEC specialist's query execution. While the system correctly reported that no records were returned, it failed to answer the question.
